description: This file defines an internal helper class 'AdoGrainKey' used for managing grain key information within Orleans storage, including constructors for different key types, hash byte generation, and string representation.

classes.name: AdoGrainKey
classes.description: A helper class for managing grain key information, supporting different key types (long, GUID, string), generating hash bytes, and string representation.

methods.name: AdoGrainKey
methods.description: Constructor for long key with extension.

methods.name: AdoGrainKey
methods.description: Constructor for GUID key with extension.

methods.name: GetHashBytes
methods.description: Generates a byte array hash representation of the key, including the string extension if present.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the key, including extension if available.
